actions.create_or_update_contact.descrip: Create a new contact or update an existing contact in Omnisend. If a contact with the same email already exists, it will be updated.
actions.create_or_update_contact.props.e: The subscription status for the email channel.
actions.create_or_update_contact.props.s: Send a welcome email to the contact upon creation.
actions.create_or_update_contact.props.t: Tags to assign to the contact.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get_contact.description: Retrieve a contact by their contact ID.
actions.list_campaigns.description: Retrieve a list of email campaigns.
actions.list_campaigns.props.offset.desc: Number of campaigns to skip for pagination.
actions.list_contacts.description: Retrieve a paginated list of contacts from Omnisend.
actions.list_contacts.props.offset.descr: Number of contacts to skip for pagination.
actions.send_customer_event.description: Send a customer event to Omnisend. Events track customer behavior and trigger automations (e.g. welcome emails, abandoned cart reminders). Use predefined events or create custom ones.
Email address of the contact to send the event for.
actions.send_customer_event.props.eventN: The name of the event. Use predefined names (e.g. "added product to cart", "placed order") or a custom event name.
actions.send_customer_event.props.proper: Custom key-value properties to include with the event (e.g. {"orderId": "12345", "totalPrice": 99.99}).
auth.description:
To obtain your Omnisend API key:
1. Log in to your [Omnisend account](https://app.omnisend.com).
2. Go to **Store settings → Integrations & API → API Keys**.
3. Click **Create API Key**, give it a name.
4. Copy the generated key and paste it here.
